Shubham Sarode

Senior Analyst +91- 8668930929 | shubshsarode@gmail.com | Pune, INDIA | Experience: 4 Years

Dedicated, detail-oriented, and results-driven Fund Accounting professional with over 4 years of experience in the financial services industry, specializing in Fund Accounting, Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, Private Equity Operations, NAV Calculation, Reconciliations, and Financial Reporting. Possess strong expertise in managing end-to-end fund accounting and NAV calculation processes, including trade processing, pricing validation, accruals, corporate actions, income and expense booking, cash & position reconciliation, NAV review, and final NAV release across multiple investment funds.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Analyst - Northern Trust Corporation

Jun 2022 - Jun 2026

Roles and Responsibilities:

Support hedge funds and mutual fund and alternative investment structures through accurate accounting, reporting and

investor servicing activities.

Managing the daily reconciliation of investment transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory

standards.

Analysis of comprehensive financial statements for multiple investment funds, consistently meeting strict reporting

deadlines.

Executed precise Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations, considering market values, income, and expenses, contributing to

reliable and transparent reporting

Actively contributed to the on-time delivery of accurate and compliant financial statements, leading to increased client

satisfaction.

Responsible for end-to-end trade processing, including trade booking, validation and reconciliation.

Reviewed and validated pricing of securities including equities, bonds, derivatives, FX and money market instruments.

Maintained investor capital accounts and partner allocations.

Coordinated with custodians, investment managers, auditors, and internal stakeholders to resolve operational queries.

PROJECTS

The comparative analysis of mutual fund wrt HDFC Bank Ltd and ICICI Bank Pvt Ltd

91 Days

Conducted a detailed comparative analysis of mutual funds relative to HDFC Bank Ltd and ICICI Bank Pvt Ltd. - Evaluated performance metrics and investment strategies for selected funds. - Analyzed financial data and compiled findings in a comprehensive report.

EDUCATION

2021 MBA/PGDM | Finance

Sinhgad Institute of Management (SIOM), Pune Marks - 76.3%

2018 B.Com | Commerce

Athavale Samajkarya College, Bhandara Marks - 61%

CUSTOM SECTION

Soft Skills

Strong analytical & problem solving

Attention to detail & accuracy

Time management & ability to meet deadlines

Team collaboration & stakeholder communication

Critical thinking & issue resolution

Adaptability and learning ability

Work prioritization under pressure

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi
